findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.citation_text:
6-403.11(B) Designated Areas. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be located in a designated room or area where contamination of FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES can not occur.

An employee phone was observed on the cutting board of a prep cooler. A cut eggplant and knife were observed next to it as well as other foods being prepared. The PIC was shown and removed the phone to correct. The cutting board was sanitized as well. Ensure that employee belongings do not become a concern for contamination of foods and equipment.
